summary: Full E2E test of HappyKids (backend + frontend, 1920px desktop and 390px mobile). Backend: 16/16 pytest pass (health, auth me/session/logout/expired, progress GET/PUT with 401 when not signed in, contact validation). Frontend: landing (hero, explore-worlds scroll, 5 world cards, CTA, footer links incl. /about#contact, no app store badges), nav + mobile menu, dashboard, daily adventure, recently played, all 5 world pages with every activity card and play button, all 9 quizzes (data-correct, wrong answer 'You picked', choice counts K=3 and odd-one-out=4), both stories (5 pages, word tap, 3 questions), memory (mismatch then 6 pairs), colour game (no crayon, wrong colour, order sun/grass/roof/sky), drawing studio (draw, undo, eraser, clear, brush, 3 challenges), done screen buttons, progress (badges, star-collector, avatar unlocks at 5 and 10, avatar select shows on dashboard, certificates, unearned cert redirects), parents (3s gate, stats, strengths, practice, recent, history, add/select/delete profile, G1 level, music and reduced-motion toggles, reset clears only the active child), signed-in cloud backup (account-email, 'saved to your account', PUT saved in Mongo, restore on a new device, sign out -> 401, Google sign-in redirect), contact form, no horizontal scroll on 11 mobile pages, route guards. No page errors. Only low/medium issues found.

ui_bugs.issue: The sessionStorage flag hc_grownup is set when the gate opens and never cleared. After leaving /parents (nav, back button, anything), /parents opens with no gate for the rest of the browser session, so a child can get into the parent area, reset progress or delete profiles. This was already reported in iteration 1 and is still open.
On the landing page, if the URL is already /#worlds and the user scrolls back up, clicking nav-worlds again does nothing because the hash doesn't change. From other pages it works.
'I did it!' gives a star even if the canvas is empty (tested after Clear). Consider requiring at least one stroke.
At 390px the note is now fixed at the top and covers the game top bar (Back button, progress dots, stars) and the top of the speech bubble until it is closed.

issues: The text says 'Grade 1 shows up to 4 and unlocks every story', but every quiz except odd-one-out only has 3 choices, and stories are not locked for Kindergarten (only the daily adventure pool skips froggy-and-the-rain). The copy promises more than Grade 1 actually does.
Each word is its own button with margin and no space character, so innerText and screen readers read 'Hoppythebunnyhada...'. Add a real space between word buttons.

action_items: Clear sessionStorage hc_grownup when ParentDashboard unmounts (or ask for the gate every time /parents is opened)
Make nav-worlds scroll to #worlds even when the hash is already #worlds (e.g. scroll on click when already on '/')
Optional: require at least one stroke before 'I did it!' in Drawing Studio
Optional: on mobile, stop the AudioHelp note from covering the game top bar (add top padding while it shows, or make it smaller)
Optional: make the Grade 1 copy match what it does (add 4th choices to quizzes or change the text); add spaces between story word buttons
critical_code_review_comments: AppState cloud sync: on sign-in the newest updatedAt wins for the whole state. If a device has newer local data (e.g. a different family's kids on a shared tablet), the cloud copy is silently overwritten by the next PUT. Consider merging per profile or asking before overwriting.
Settings changes and setActive don't change updatedAt, so a settings-only change is uploaded with the old timestamp and may lose to another device's state later. Minor.
Logout keeps all child data in localStorage on the device. Acceptable for this design, just confirming it is intended.
GET /api/progress returns updated_at stored as a Mongo Long. It works, but consider an int64-safe or ISO value.
POST /api/auth/session calls data['email'] etc. without checking the keys. A bad upstream payload would cause a 500 instead of a 401. Minor.
StrictMode in dev sends GET /api/auth/me and /api/progress twice (harmless).

success_rate.frontend: ~96%: all requested flows work; 1 medium (gate bypass) and 3 low issues

seed_data_creation: Made TEST_ users/sessions in Mongo for auth tests, plus 1 progress doc and 2 contact_messages. All were deleted by id afterwards. Browser localStorage was only used in throwaway test browsers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each browser_automation call starts a fresh context (localStorage empty), so play activities and check progress in the same script. Quiz answers: [data-correct=true]. In the colour game, a center click on region-house lands on the door. Gate: mouse.down, wait 3.4s, mouse.up. Auth: insert a user and session into test_database and add cookie session_token (secure, sameSite None) for little-hops--9ih8ueav.preview.emergentagent.com. Total puzzles = 77. 49 stars after all quizzes and stories with every answer right first time.
